generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each forecast row shows weighted pipeline, run-rate, blend, manual adjustment, and prior accuracy.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Territory and channel forecasts sum to the published headline forecast.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Forecast version, blend ratio, and refresh timestamp retained in the BI workspace.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual leadership adjustments logged as separate disclosed lines with a reason.
generic.Test population: All territories and channels in the forecast scope for the rolling horizon.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Forecast covers the full horizon with pipeline and run-rate shown separately.
generic.Exception handling path: Adjustments without a stated reason are removed rather than embedded in the model.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Forecast produced when blended, disclosed, accuracy-reported, and rolled forward.
generic.Evidence location: BI/reporting platform rolling forecast dataset and the forecast accuracy log.

steps.title: Weight open pipeline by stage probability across the horizon
sop: Apply stage probabilities to open CRM opportunities across the horizon
Roll the weighted values up by territory and channel
Record the probability table version used
Done when weighted pipeline covers the full rolling horizon
verify: Check horizon coverage against the agreed number of forward periods
Pass when the weighted pipeline covers every forward period in the horizon

steps.title: Blend weighted pipeline with trailing run-rate
sop: Pull trailing run-rate by territory and channel from the warehouse
Apply the documented blend ratio
Show weighted pipeline and run-rate separately on the output
Done when the blended forecast is produced with inputs shown separately
verify: Check the output for separately displayed inputs
Pass when weighted pipeline and run-rate are shown separately from the blend

steps.title: Disclose manual leadership adjustments as a separate line
sop: Record any leadership adjustment as its own visible line
State the reason and requester for each adjustment
Never embed adjustments inside the modelled figures
Done when every adjustment appears as a disclosed separate line
verify: Compare modelled output against the published forecast
Pass when manual adjustments are disclosed separately rather than embedded

steps.title: Report prior forecast versus actual accuracy
sop: Retrieve the prior forecast from the accuracy log
Compute the accuracy percentage against the actual result
Show it next to the new forecast
Done when prior accuracy is displayed with the new forecast
verify: Recompute the prior accuracy percentage
Pass when the displayed accuracy matches the recomputed value

steps.title: Roll the horizon forward and reconcile the components
sop: Advance the rolling horizon so it always covers the agreed forward periods
Sum territory and channel forecasts against the headline
Correct any component that does not reconcile
Done when the horizon is rolled forward and components reconcile
verify: Sum the components against the headline forecast
Pass when components sum exactly to the published headline forecast

steps.title: Review and release the forecast with the Distribution Operations Manager
sop: Review the blend, adjustments, and accuracy statement
Challenge adjustments without a stated reason
Approve the forecast for release
Done when the forecast is approved and released
verify: Check the forecast record for the approval entry
Pass when the released forecast carries a dated management approval

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound policies in the policy administration extract and closed-won records in CRM for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period closed to the reconciliation cut-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each compared row shows policy number, bound premium, producer code, and system of origin.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy count and premium agree between the two systems within the agreed tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation workbook saved with the run date and the residual difference stated.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every one-sided record and premium difference logged with its investigated cause.
generic.Test population: All bound policies and closed-won opportunities for the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every bound policy has a matching CRM record and the residual difference is within tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: CRM attribution errors corrected at source rather than adjusting the report output.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciled when both directions are cleared, signed off, and residual issues are logged.
generic.Evidence location: Reconciliation workbook in the reporting folder and the CRM correction audit trail.

steps.title: Extract bound policies and CRM closed-won records for the period
sop: Extract bound policy count and premium from the policy administration platform
Extract closed-won records with premium from CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics)
Load both into the Microsoft Excel reconciliation workbook
Done when both extracts are loaded for the period
verify: Compare each extract total against its source report
Pass when both extracts tie to their own source reports

steps.title: Match records by policy number in both directions
sop: Match policy administration records to CRM closed-won records on policy number
Produce the unmatched list in both directions
Record the counts on each side
Done when the two-directional match is complete
verify: Check the unmatched lists against the extract counts
Pass when matched plus unmatched equals each extract total

steps.title: Investigate premium differences above tolerance
sop: List matched policies with a premium difference above tolerance
Investigate and record the cause as timing, endorsement, or attribution error
Escalate causes that cannot be determined
Done when every material premium difference has a recorded cause
verify: Check the difference list for items without a cause
Pass when every difference above tolerance carries a recorded cause

steps.title: Correct CRM attribution errors at source
sop: Correct producer, channel, or premium attribution errors in CRM
Do not adjust the report output to mask the error
Record each correction with its cause
Done when identified CRM attribution errors are corrected at source
verify: Re-run the match after corrections
Pass when every bound policy in the policy extract has a matching CRM closed-won record

steps.title: Log unresolved items as data issues with owners
sop: Raise each unresolved reconciliation item as a data issue
Assign a named owner and a target resolution date
Track them on the weekly operations issue log
Done when every unresolved item is logged with an owner
verify: Check the data issue log against the unresolved list
Pass when every unresolved reconciliation item has a logged issue and owner

steps.title: Sign off the reconciliation with the residual difference stated
sop: State the residual unexplained difference in value and percentage
Confirm it sits inside the agreed tolerance
Record the sign-off name and date on the workbook
Done when the reconciliation is signed off with the residual stated
verify: Open the workbook and read the residual and sign-off
Pass when the residual unexplained difference is stated and within the agreed tolerance
